text: What is the most embarrassing song on your playlist?
What is a food combination you love that others find weird?
What is the silliest thing you have ever been afraid of?

What is a movie everyone loves that you secretly dislike?
What is the longest you have gone without washing a particular item of clothing?
What is your most useless talent?
What is the most awkward first impression someone has had of you?
What is the biggest lie you told to get out of plans?
Which person in this room would you trust most with a secret, and why?
What is the most embarrassing thing in your search history that you would admit to?
What is something you pretended to like just to fit in?
What is the worst gift you have ever given or received?
What is the pettiest reason you have stopped talking to someone?
What is one thing you would change about how this group hangs out?
What is the most cringe thing you did to impress someone?
Which friend in this room would survive longest in a disaster movie, and who would go first?
What is your most controversial opinion that you rarely share?
What is a rule you break all the time and feel no guilt about?
Do your best impression of another player until your next turn.
Speak in a dramatic movie-trailer voice for the next two turns.
Do ten jumping jacks while reciting the alphabet.
Show the group the last photo in your gallery, or skip if you prefer.
Invent a handshake with the player on your left and perform it.
Balance a spoon on your nose for ten seconds.
Let the group pick a nickname for you that you must use for the rest of the game.
Sing the chorus of a song of the group's choice, with full emotion.
Walk like a runway model across the room and back.
Do an interpretive dance of your morning routine.
Talk without moving your lips until your next turn.
Perform a one-minute stand-up comedy set about the person on your right (keep it kind).
Act out a famous movie scene and let the group guess it.
Make up a rap about everyone in the room, one line each.
Let another player style your hair however they like.
Give a dramatic acceptance speech for an award you have not won.
Would you rather only eat pizza forever or never eat pizza again?
Would you rather always be ten minutes late or twenty minutes early?
Would you rather have no phone for a month or no friends' texts for a month?
Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses?
Would you rather have everyone read your messages or hear your thoughts for a day?
Would you rather sing everything you say or dance everywhere you walk?
Would you rather lose your phone or lose your wallet for a week?
Would you rather be famous for something embarrassing or unknown for something great?
Would you rather give up music forever or give up movies forever?
Would you rather know the date you will die or the way you will die?
Would you rather always say what you think or never speak your mind?
Would you rather relive your worst day or skip your best day?
Would you rather be the smartest person in the room or the funniest?
Would you rather have a rewind button or a pause button for your life?
What is your favourite small thing your partner does without noticing?
Plan your perfect lazy Sunday together in one minute.
What song reminds you most of your partner?
Recreate your first meeting as dramatically as possible.
What is one thing you want to try together this year?
What is a habit of your partner's you secretly find adorable?
Guess your partner's go-to comfort food. Score if you are right.
Give your partner a compliment that is not about looks.
What is one small thing your partner could do to make your week better?
Describe your partner in exactly three words and explain each.
What is the funniest argument you two have ever had over nothing?
Plan a surprise date for your partner and pitch it in thirty seconds.
